claude.sample_unit: orthopaedic patient education documents (86 with human easy-to-read versions used for fidelity analysis)

links.outcome: Reading grade level of original orthopaedic PEMs versus recommended sixth-grade level
links.effect: Original Epic Elsevier orthopaedic PEMs exceeded the sixth-grade level, mean grade 8.6 in English and 5.8 in Spanish.
links.quote: Orthopaedic patient education materials (PEMs) within Epic's Elsevier library often exceed the recommended sixth-grade reading level, with a mean grade of 8.6 in English and 5.8 in Spanish, risking poor patient comprehension and adherence.

links.outcome: Reading grade level of PEMs after ChatGPT-4o plain-language simplification
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o-simplified PEMs had mean reading grade levels of 6.1 in English and 3.5 in Spanish, with acceptable fidelity.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o-simplified PEMs showed mean reading grade levels of 6.1 in English and 3.5 in Spanish.

links.outcome: Hallucinations, omissions, and inconsistencies in ChatGPT-simplified PEMs versus human simplifications, by language
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o had comparable English hallucinations but higher Spanish hallucinations than human versions; ChatGPT-5 reduced Spanish hallucinations to human-comparable rates.
links.quote: Compared with human simplifications, ChatGPT-4o showed fewer English omissions, similar Spanish omissions, fewer inconsistencies in both languages, and comparable English hallucinations, but higher Spanish hallucinations.
